title: This Book Is Gay
author: Juno Dawson
current_text: The book was challenged in Wasilla, Alaska, after a boy picked it up from the juvenile non-fiction shelf of the public library, in a report dated 26 Nov 2015. In a survey reported on 19 Aug 2024, Index on Censorship said 53% of librarians polled had been asked to remove books, and This Book Is Gay by Juno Dawson was among the titles complained about.

ban_rows.note: Removed or formally challenged in UK secondary-school libraries during the 2023-2024 Index on Censorship survey of UK school librarians, in which 53% of respondents had been asked to remove a book and 56% of those requests led to removal. Predominantly anti-LGBTQ+ challenges driven by parents. Source: Index on Censorship — Banned: school librarians shushed over LGBT+ books.
